english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for amusing or pleasing someone.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice for pleasing or entertaining someone.
Use this when someone deliberately says or does something to cheer another person up or keep them happy.

examples.english: I tell jokes to entertain people.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 siu3 waa6 tam2 jan4 hoi1 sam1

examples.english: They really know how to amuse people.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sik1 tam2 jan4 hoi1 sam1

examples.english: They often tell jokes to please people.
examples.traditional: 佢成日講笑話氹人開心。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 siu3 waa6 tam2 jan4 hoi1 sam1
